summary: Iteration 35 — Full Playwright E2E for Kreeda Nation Phase 3 / 4 / 5 + BracketView + canvas share. Seeded 7 events (pickleball, snooker, chess, tabletennis, knockout, swiss, double_elim) via /app/test_reports/seed_iter35_events.py using admin@kreedanation.com/admin123, then ran 11 end-to-end browser flows. 11/11 PASSED. Backend regression suites test_phase3_phase4.py (14/14) and test_phase5_sport_rules.py (7/7) were already green (per main-agent note) and were not re-executed. Zero P0/P1 bugs found in this iteration.

design_issues.screen: Platform admin — Events / EventDetail on first login
issues: The 'Welcome to Kreeda Nation HQ' first-time-orientation modal (data-testid=welcome-modal) is a z=60 full-screen overlay that intercepts all pointer events until dismissed. Playwright's first pass was fully blocked. Consider (a) auto-dismiss on ESC or backdrop click, (b) always render close-X inside modal even for keyboard-only users, (c) persist dismissed state to backend user prefs instead of only localStorage so cross-device sessions don't repeatedly interrupt Admin flows. Not a bug per se, but reduces UX and makes automated smoke-tests fragile.

critical_code_review_comments: LiveScorer.jsx (305 LOC) — sport-aware branching (racket/frame/chess/generic) is clean; SideEditor is well-factored. Small nit: on line 241 the 'else' branch for 'other' sports duplicates the fallback score input already handled implicitly — safe but could tighten with an explicit `sport==='other'` check to avoid future regression.

sports.js::computeMatchOutcome — correct handling of best-of-N + deuce + hard_cap. TT test verified sets 5-0 does NOT count (needs 11), which matches _setWinner's `pa<target && pb<target => null` guard. Good.
shareBracketImage.js — uses `canvas.roundRect` conditionally (line 168), which is Chrome-only until recently. It has an `? : rect(...)` fallback so it works on older browsers. Solid.

BracketView.jsx — filters WB/LB/GF by `bracket_position` startsWith prefix — depends on backend emitting these prefixes exactly. Consider adding a defensive fallback to render everything under a single 'Bracket' section if prefixes aren't set. Currently double-elim rendered correctly.

EventDetail.jsx — bracket TabsTrigger + TabsContent (lines 257, 272-276) correctly gated on `['knockout','double_elimination'].includes(event.format)`; swiss / round_robin do not get a bracket tab, matching product intent.
WelcomeModal (frontend) — non-dismissable overlay traps E2E tests + real admins. See design_issues above.

rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA in iter35 — all requested flows work end-to-end. The only friction encountered was the mandatory first-time WelcomeModal on /platform-admin routes intercepting clicks until user seeds the dismissed flag. This is not a functional bug — merely a UX consideration for main agent to decide whether to auto-dismiss on outside click / ESC.
